mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates and signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.5%, it signals persistent economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) signals a strong economy with accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 215 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a low interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND INDPRO > 100 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity, compressing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550, it signals weak consumer demand and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 550 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining housing starts (HOUST < 550) and falling residential sales (RSAFS < 350000) signals a deepening housing market crisis, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 550 AND RSAFS < 350000 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 9.5%), rising employment (PAYEMS > 129000) signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5% AND PAYEMS > 129000 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).
